title: figma-developer-mcp passes tool input into a shell command
summary: The Framelink figma-developer-mcp server built a curl command string with unsanitised input inside fetchWithRetry and ran it through child_process.exec, so shell metacharacters in a get_figma_data request executed as commands. Versions up to and including 0.6.2 are affected; 0.6.3 fixes it.
severity_rationale: Command execution in the MCP server process, reachable by any content the agent is asked to fetch through the tool.
